permission.label: Asks you first
permission.description: A pop up asks for your OK before the app gets it.

picker.label: You pick what to share
picker.description: You choose the exact items (a photo, a file, a contact).

capability.label: Works without asking
capability.description: A useful feature apps can just use. No pop up.

action.label: Does something on your device
action.description: Makes the device act: vibrate, share, keep the screen on.

signal.label: Gets silently
signal.description: A detail about you or your device that apps can get with no prompt.

tracking.label: Used to track you
tracking.description: Mostly used to follow you across apps, sites or ads.

not-exposed.label: Blocked for apps
not-exposed.description: Apps can't get this, or it was taken away from them.

location-motion.label: Location and motion
location-motion.description: Where you are and how you move

personal-data-contacts.label: Contacts and personal data
personal-data-contacts.description: Your people, photos, calendar and more

health-fitness.label: Health and fitness
health-fitness.description: Steps, heart rate, workouts, health records

identity-auth.label: Sign in and identity
identity-auth.description: Face ID, passkeys, accounts and logins

notifications-background.label: Notifications and background
notifications-background.description: Alerts and work that runs when the app is closed

device-system-profile.label: Device details
device-system-profile.description: Model, memory, battery and other facts about the device

display-window.label: Screen and windows
display-window.description: Screen size, brightness, full screen, windows

input-clipboard.label: Typing and clipboard
input-clipboard.description: Keyboard, copy and paste, touch and mouse

locale-preferences.label: Language and settings
locale-preferences.description: Language, time zone, dark mode, text size

timing-performance.label: Speed and timing
timing-performance.description: How fast things load and run

on-device-ai.label: On-device AI
on-device-ai.description: AI that runs right on your device

system-control.label: System control
system-control.description: Changing device settings and controlling other apps

telephony-sms.label: Calls and texts
telephony-sms.description: Phone calls, SMS and carrier details

app-ecosystem.label: Other apps on the phone
app-ecosystem.description: Seeing and talking to other installed apps

attribution-ads.label: Ads and install tracking
attribution-ads.description: Measuring which ad led to an install or sale

cross-site-tracking.label: Tracking across apps and sites
cross-site-tracking.description: IDs and tricks that follow you around

rendering-fingerprint.label: Graphics and fingerprinting
rendering-fingerprint.description: Drawing and the hidden device clues it leaks

page-actions.label: Things a page can do
page-actions.description: Actions a website can take for you

reach.2: While you use it, or only what you choose
reach.3: Ongoing or in the background, one kind of data
reach.4: Broad: everything of that type, anytime

scores.sensitivity: 1 to 5, how revealing the data is
scores.utility: 1 to 5, how useful it is to honest apps
scores.friction: 1 to 5, how much the user has to do
scores.fingerprint_bits: Rough bits of identifying entropy, when known
